title: Fix nested path reporting, bool-vs-int check, and additionalProperties in validator
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `mini_schema/` (`types.py`, `validator.py`):
1. In Python `isinstance(True, int)` is `True`! Ensure schema type `'integer'` rejects booleans (`True`/`False`), and `'boolean'` only accepts `bool`.
2. When `additionalProperties` is `False` on an `'object'` schema, any unexpected key must produce a validation error.
3. Nested errors must report the full dotted/indexed path (e.g. `user.age` or `items[1].name`), not just the leaf key.
Run `pytest` to verify.
